simple_description: Damage to the peripheral nerves outside the brain and spinal cord, causing chronic burning pain, numbness, tingling, and muscle weakness, typically starting in the feet and hands.
medical_description: A diffuse symmetrical or multifocal disorder of the peripheral nervous system affecting sensory, motor, or autonomic fibers. Characteristically presents in a length-dependent 'glove-and-stocking' distribution affecting the longest distal axons first.
affected_system: Peripheral somatic sensory, motor, and autonomic nerve fibers and Schwann cell myelin sheaths.
symptoms: Gradual onset of numbness, prickling, or tingling (paresthesia) starting in feet or toes and spreading upward
Burning, freezing, electric, or throbbing pain, often worsening at night
Extreme sensitivity to light touch (allodynia: even bedsheets cause pain)
Sensory ataxia: lack of coordination and falling in the dark due to loss of position sense (proprioception)
Muscle weakness, foot drop, or muscle cramping in advanced stages
Autonomic signs: dry feet, orthostatic dizziness, gastrointestinal dysmotility
early_warning_signs: Tingling or burning sensations on the soles of the feet after walking or at bedtime
possible_causes: Vitamin B12 deficiency and chronic alcohol toxicity
Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN: taxanes, platinums, vincristine)
Autoimmune (CIDP, Sjögren's, vasculitis), hypothyroidism, renal failure
risk_factors: Poorly controlled diabetes, chronic alcoholism, nutritional deficiencies, older age
clinical_evaluation: 10-gram Semmes-Weinstein monofilament testing, 128-Hz tuning fork vibration testing, pinprick and temperature testing, Romberg sign.
diagnostic_tests: Nerve Conduction Studies (NCS) and Electromyography (EMG) - Distinguishes axonal from demyelinating neuropathy
Screening blood panel: HbA1c, Fasting glucose, Serum Vitamin B12, Methylmalonic acid, TSH, Serum protein electrophoresis with immunofixation (SPEP/IFE to rule out paraproteinemic neuropathy)
Skin punch biopsy with Intraepidermal Nerve Fiber Density (IENFD) - Diagnostic for small-fiber neuropathy
treatment_overview: Treat the underlying etiology (strict glycemic control in diabetes, Vitamin B12 replenishment, cessation of alcohol). Pharmacological management of neuropathic pain with gabapentinoids, SNRIs, or tricyclic antidepressants. Meticulous daily foot care to prevent undetected diabetic ulcers.
medication_classes: First-line Gabapentinoids: Pregabalin (75-300 mg daily), Gabapentin (300-1800 mg daily)
First-line SNRIs: Duloxetine (60-120 mg daily - FDA approved for diabetic neuropathy)
Tricyclic Antidepressants: Amitriptyline, Nortriptyline (10-50 mg nocte)
Topical therapies: Capsaicin 8% dermal patch, Lidocaine 5% patch
precautions: Inspect feet daily with a mirror for cuts, blisters, or calluses; wear wide protective footwear
prevention: Tight blood sugar management (HbA1c < 7.0%), avoidance of heavy alcohol, B-vitamin supplementation
complications: Unnoticed foot ulceration leading to osteomyelitis and lower extremity amputation
emergency_signs: Rapidly progressive ascending weakness spreading over days (indicative of Guillain-Barré Syndrome)

faqs.question: Can damaged peripheral nerves heal?
faqs.answer: Yes, peripheral nerves can regenerate slowly (about 1 mm per day) if the underlying cause (such as high blood sugar or vitamin deficiency) is corrected early before the nerve cells die completely.

hi.name: पेरिफेरल न्यूरोपैथी / नसों की कमजोरी (Peripheral Neuropathy)
hi.summary: हाथों और पैरों की नसों में खराबी जिससे तलवों में जलन, सुई चुभने जैसी झनझनाहट, सुन्नपन और कमजोरी होती है (डायबिटीज इसका मुख्य कारण है)।
hi.advice: डायबिटीज को नियंत्रित रखें, विटामिन B12 चेक करवाएं और रोजाना पैरों की जांच करें। न्यूरोलॉजिस्ट से प्रीगाबेलिन या डुलॉक्सेटीन दवा लें।

hinglish.name: Peripheral Neuropathy (Pair ke talvo me jalan aur sunn-pan)
hinglish.summary: Sugar ya B12 ki kami se pair me aag jaisi jalan, jhanjhanahat aur chappal nikalne ka pata na chalna.
hinglish.advice: Sugar control karein, nange pair na chalein aur Pregabalin dawai lein.

ur.name: پیریفیرل نیوروپیتھی (اعصابی کمزوری اور جلن)
ur.summary: ہاتھوں اور پیروں کے اعصاب کی کمزوری، جلن، سن پن اور سوئیاں چبھنے کا احساس۔
ur.advice: شوگر کا سخت کنٹرول رکھیں اور پاؤں کی روزانہ دیکھ بھال کریں۔
